title: A blacksmith’s son founds Fascism in a Milan hall
episode: Benito Mussolini Part 1: Italy's Fascist Godfather
description: Paul McGann narrates the rise of Benito Mussolini, the socialist editor turned dictator. In March 1919 he founded the Fasci di Combattimento, the first Fascist movement, at a meeting in a hall on Piazza San Sepolcro, a small square near the Duomo.

title: The dictator is caught fleeing, and his body is hung in a Milan square
description: In April 1945 partisans caught Mussolini disguised in a German convoy by Lake Como and shot him. His body, with Clara Petacci’s, was hung upside down at a petrol station on Piazzale Loreto, the square where Fascists had displayed shot partisans in 1944.

title: Young Fascists dig up Mussolini’s body and hide it for months
description: Mussolini was buried in an unmarked grave in Milan’s Cimitero Maggiore cemetery. In April 1946 neo-Fascist Domenico Leccisi and friends dug him up and hid the body; it was recovered and later reburied in his home town, Predappio.
